description: List the models in the AbliteratedLLM catalog with context length, max output tokens, input types (text, image, video) and prices in USD per 1M tokens (input, output, cached input, and priority tier where offered). variant "abliterated" means the refusal behavior was removed from the weights; "stock" models are the vendors' original weights. Every model reasons. Reads the public catalog; no API key needed.

max_output_price.description: Only models whose output price is at most this many USD per 1M tokens.

vision.description: true: only models that accept image input; false: only models that don't.

name: list_models

pricing.description: USD per 1M tokens as decimal strings. priority: prices of the priority tier, null when the model has none.

variant.description: "abliterated": refusal behavior removed from the weights; "stock": the vendor's original weights.

title: List AbliteratedLLM models
